requirements.requirement: Existing data under /srv/inventory owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers
requirements.summary: Baseline showed root:root ownership (cmd-f0aa6f722404444c). Executor created the inventorysvc system user and inventory-readers group, then chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory, verified recursively across /srv/inventory, /srv/inventory/data, config.json, and records.csv (cmd-2949922525ea4ef7). Ownership persisted after a full restart cycle (cmd-d57b0ff7bf6c44e7).

requirements.requirement: Data readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
requirements.summary: chmod applied 750 to all directories and 640 to all files under /srv/inventory, verified via recursive listing showing inventory-readers group with read/execute-into access while the 'other' bit is 0 in both modes, blocking non-owner/non-group access (cmd-2949922525ea4ef7). Post-restart verification confirms the same 750/640 modes and inventorysvc/inventory-readers persisted (cmd-d57b0ff7bf6c44e7).

requirements.requirement: Existing contents of /srv/inventory preserved (not deleted or altered)
requirements.summary: Baseline captured config.json and records.csv content/checksums via prepare stage. After the ownership/permission repair, executor displayed config.json content ({"site":"north","generation":4}) and records.csv line count (2), matching pre-change state, and re-confirmed identical content post-restart, indicating chown/chmod-only changes with no data modification.

overall_summary: The executor correctly repaired /srv/inventory ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers) and permissions (750 dirs / 640 files), verified data preservation both immediately after the change and after a full node restart, and produced coherent restart-protocol evidence (boot_id 92ec88af... -> 4a66a9a9..., recovered service/user/group/data state). All material outcomes are satisfied with direct evidence and hygiene is clean.
limitations: Post-change verification relied on displaying file content and line counts rather than recomputing sha256 checksums as in the prepare baseline, so byte-for-byte integrity is inferred rather than cryptographically confirmed.
The restart-evidence protocol covers only node1, which is the sole managed node in this topology, so no cross-node comparison was possible.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands (groupadd, useradd, chown -R, chmod on dirs/files, and the reboot) map directly to task requirements or the mandatory restart-evidence protocol. The two non-zero-return-code commands (cmd-4826d75e17394753 reboot ack disconnect, cmd-87705a625ab440b0 poll timeout) are expected artifacts of a live reboot sequence, not failed or unnecessary mutations. Lifecycle diff (executor_comparison) shows only expected reboot-driven changes (boot-identity, ephemeral systemd-private tmp dirs, transient socket listing during startup) with no failed services, no package-health degradation, and no unrelated residue. No unnecessary or unreverted mutations were identified.
